en: The postcard depicts a black-and-white photograph of a solid, two-story building made of stone and stucco, with large windows and a hipped roof. The building is situated on an open field, with some trees and a forested area in the background. There are stairs leading up to an entrance with a small canopy. The words 'Turnhalle Geyer i. Erzgeb.' are printed on the lower left corner of the image.
